sentences.fa: می خوام در رو قفل کنم.
sentences.en: I am gonna lock the door.

sentences.fa: دارم در رو باز می کنم.
sentences.en: I am opening the door.
I have opened the door.

sentences.fa: تا اونجايي که من مي دونم برادرم در رو قفل کرد.
sentences.en: As far as I know, my brother locked the door.
Are you sure the doctor examined you?
My mother visited you.

sentences.fa: چيکار کنم؟ بابام به پليس زنگ زد.
sentences.en: What shall I do? My father called the police.
Did your brother invite you?

sentences.fa: کجا داري مي ري؟ مادرم شام رو کشيد.
sentences.en: Where are you going? My mother served the dinner.
Where did your father put my money?
Why did your father park here?

sentences.fa: پدرت گردن بندم رو تعمير کرد؟
sentences.en: Did your father fix (repair) my necklace?

sentences.fa: در مورد چي داري حرف مي کني؟
sentences.en: What are you talking about?
My mother bought a gift for you.
Did your colleague hire a lawyer for you?

sentences.fa: چرا پدرت براي مهاجرت به کانادا اقدام کرد؟
sentences.en: Why did your father apply for immigration to Canada?

sentences.fa: تا اونجايي که مي دونم، همسايه ام به ساختمان ديگه اي نقل و مکان کرد.
sentences.en: As far as I know, my neighbor moved to another building.
Did your father cash my check?
My father drew a check for you.

sentences.fa: چرا پدرت چک رو به اسم من کشيد؟
sentences.en: Why did your father make a check out to me?
Where did your father put it?
Did your mother take a taxi for you?
How much money did your father send for you?
My father saw me.
My father has seen me.
My mother locked the door.
My mother has locked the door.
Did your father invite you?
Has your father invited you?

sentences.fa: پدرت ماشن رو کجا پارک کرد؟
sentences.en: Where did your husband park the car?

sentences.fa: پدرت ماشين رو کجا پارک کرده؟
sentences.en: Where has your father parked the car?
Did your husband buy a gift for you?
Has your husband bought a gift for you?
He bought a ring for me.
He has bought a ring for me.

sentences.fa: داري شوخي مي کني، رئيسم اخراجم کرد؟
sentences.en: You are pulling my leg, did my boss fired me?
Has my boss fired me?
Why has my boss fired me?
What did your father order?
What has your father ordered?
Why did your mother go?
Where has your mother gone?
Are you sure your mother invited me?
Are you sure your mother has invited me?

sentences.fa: خانمت براي شام چي درست کرد.
sentences.en: What did your wife cook for dinner?

sentences.fa: خانمت براي شام چي درست کرده؟
sentences.en: What has your wife cooked for dinner?

sentences.fa: مادرم همه چي رو بهم گفت.
sentences.en: My mother told me everything.

sentences.fa: مادرم همه چي رو بهم گفته.
sentences.en: My mother has told me everything.
Did your father fix the car?
Has your father fixed the car?
He saw me.
He has seen me.
The doctor married me.
The doctor has married.
My mother stayed at home.
My mother has stayed at home.
Why has your mother stayed at home?
Why did your mother stayed at home?

sentences.fa: براي چي مادرت در رو قفل کرده؟
sentences.en: Why has your mother locked the door?
My mother spoke with you.
My mother has spoken with you.
Where did your father put the car?
Where has your father put the car?
Why did your mother wash the dishes?

sentences.fa: براي چي مادرت ظرفها رو شسته؟
sentences.en: Why has your mother washed the dishes?

sentences.fa: در رو قفل کنم؟ پدرم کليد رو برده.
sentences.en: Shall I lock the door? My father has taken the key.
Did your father take the key?

sentences.fa: تا اونجايي که من مي دونم، کليد رو برد.
sentences.en: As far as I know, he took the key.
He has taken the key.

sentences.fa: پدرت شام خورده؟ چيزي براي خوردن نداريم.
sentences.en: Has your father eaten dinner? We haven't got anything to eat.
What did your father eat?
What has your father eaten?

sentences.fa: رئيسم همه چي رو توضيح داد.
sentences.en: My boss explained everything.

sentences.fa: پدرم همه چي رو توضيح داده.
sentences.en: My boss has explained everything.
Did your sister bring anything for you?
What has your sister brought for you?

sentences.fa: چيکار کنم؟ اون من رو ديده.
sentences.en: What shall I do? He has seen me.
My mother arrived home.
My mother has arrived home.
When did your mother arrive?
When has your mother arrived?

sentences.fa: چرا پدرت پول شام رو پرداخت کرد؟
sentences.en: Why did your father pay for dinner?

sentences.fa: پدرت براي چي پول شام رو پرداخت کرده؟
sentences.en: Why has your father paid for dinner?
He has arrived.
He said.
He has said.
He has resigned.
My colleague resigned.
My colleague has resigned.

sentences.fa: نگران شوهرتم، براي چي نمي رسه؟
sentences.en: I am worried about your husband, why doesn't he arrive?
He has arrived home.
He broke the window.
I am sure, he has broken the window.

sentences.fa: غائب بودم، برادرت کلاس رو ضبط کرده؟
sentences.en: I was absent, has your brother recorded the class?
Did your brother record the class?
I am sure, he has recorded the class.

sentences.fa: خاک توي سرم، اون من رو لخت ديده.
sentences.en: I could kick myself; he has seen me in the nude.
Why did your father come back?
Why has your father come back?

words.fa: چک را به اسم کسي کشيدن
چيزي رو به اسم کسي زدن
